ios.desc:
VoiceInk is your personal voice-to-text app that helps to type 5x faster with AI-powered dictation. You can also use it to captures your ideas and thoughts with remarkable accuracy. 

Key Features:
- Local AI Transcription: Transcribe your voice completely offline using local models for utmost privacy and security
- Cloud AI Services: Access industry-leading AI transcription services including Groq, Deepgram, Cerebras, and Gemini using your own API keys
- Customizable Modes: Create specialized transcription profiles for different use cases (meetings, interviews, lectures, etc.)
- Searchable History: Find any past transcript instantly with powerful search across all your recordings
- Multi-Provider Support: Choose from multiple AI services to get the best transcription quality for your needs
- Privacy-First Design: Keep your audio completely private with local processing, or use cloud services with your own API keys


Privacy First:

- Local processing option keeps your audio completely private
- No data stored on external servers unless you choose cloud providers
